evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A GPT-4o-based pipeline generated questions from 23 ECG references and Computing in Cardiology proceedings from 2003-2025.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We evaluated three commercial and 20 open-source language models on a held-out test set in a zero-shot setting.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Five open-source models with 7-14B parameters were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation, with BERT and BiomedBERT included as supervised encoder baselines.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
